titel: Pitch: a student café on campus

zeilen.s: Good morning everyone. Today I want to pitch an idea for a student café on campus.
Uh, first of all, let me show you why we need it.
Right now there is only one place to get coffee, and at ten o'clock the line is, um, very long.
We asked forty students, and most of them said they would buy there every day.
Moving on to the costs. The rent is low because the university has a free room.
So, uh, our break-even is at about eighty cups a day.
Uh, the menu would be simple: coffee, tea and sandwiches.
To sum up, a small café would save time and, um, make campus a nicer place.
Thank you. I'm happy to take your questions.
